h1: Window cleaning in The Pointe at Lake Pointe
intro: The Pointe is the only gated part of Lake Pointe and the closest to Lake Austin, with homes from $1M to $1.5M and beyond. CleanzATX arrives with your code on file and cleans glass the lake air likes to spot.

sections.h2: What The Pointe homes are like
paragraphs: Of all the Lake Pointe sections, The Pointe is the only one behind a gate, and it sits nearest the water. Homes here are priced from about $1 million to $1.5 million and above, and there is a sub association on top of the Lake Pointe HOA. Gate access means quieter streets and fewer cars, and it also means vendors need a name on the list. We handle that with a text and a code before we show up.
The houses are larger custom feeling homes with stone and stucco, deep porches and generous glass facing the lake side.

sections.h2: What The Pointe windows deal with
paragraphs: Closeness to the water matters. Lake air carries moisture and minerals, and the glass nearest the lake gets a faint film that sprinklers then deepen with white spots. Over several seasons those spots can etch, so early treatment pays off. Treatment is $10 per pane, and plans with hard water removal include up to 5 windows each visit.

Pollen settles thickly in spring, and west facing panes toward the lake show every streak in afternoon sun. Stone and stucco are soft washed with the 12V system, which protects limestone from the damage a pressure washer can do.

Because of the gate, we ask in the quote text for a code or the gate contact, and we confirm the day before. Our truck is a skid unit with 200 gallons of water on board, so we do not need to hook into your spigot, which is helpful on a quiet street. Poles reach up to three stories, which covers the tall lakeside walls. Owners often take the Every 2 Months plan to keep lake film off, saving 20%.
Take a 4,000 square foot home. Exterior windows come to about $400, taking roughly three to four hours on site. Adding the interior at $15 a window brings it to about $600.

faq.q: Who handles the gate at The Pointe?
faq.a: Send the code or the gate contact when you text for a quote. We note it on the job sheet and confirm the day before the visit.

faq.q: Does lake air really affect my windows?
faq.a: It can. Moist, mineral heavy air leaves a thin film, and sprinklers add spots. Cleaning with pure water prevents buildup that would otherwise etch the glass.

faq.q: Do you need my outdoor water?
faq.a: No. We carry 200 gallons on the truck, along with a pure water system, so we do not need your spigot for window work.

faq.q: Can I get a plan that keeps the lakeside glass clear?
faq.a: Yes. Every 2 Months saves 20% and includes a yearly free screen cleaning, hard water removal on up to 5 windows and the 7 day rain guarantee.

faq.q: Do you also clean stone walls and roofs?
faq.a: Yes, with soft wash only. House soft wash starts at $0.20 per square foot, and roof soft wash starts at $0.25 per square foot, both with a $400 minimum.
